blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police arrested a 23-year-old man wanted on a statutory rape charge in Rosario, La Union, on Friday, Oct. 9, according to the Ilocos Sur Police Provincial Office (ISPPO). The suspect, who was listed as Narvacan, Ilocos Sur’s most wanted person at the municipal level, was arrested by personnel of the Narvacan Municipal Police Station in Barangay Bani, Rosario, the ISPPO said in a statement. The warrant recommended no bail for the statutory rape charge, police said. READ: PNP: Nueva Ecija cop held over alleged statutory rape The ISPPO, led by provincial director Col.
